resolution.note: standards check --tasks writes ready tasks; harvest --repos reads registry; tests in standards-registry.test.ts

title: standards check failures in adopted repositories become ready tasks and recurring ones harvest into records
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114d slice 7: the brain reaches no project until adoption succeeds; after it does, failures must flow back.
Outcome: each failing standard in an adopted repo becomes a ready task there; krn standards harvest --repos yields candidates from adopted repos.
Proof: harvest yields >=1 candidate from an adopted repository.
